title: Read-only cross-provider handoff with egress audit
summary: ValueRoute answers whether a multi-agent task should stay on the host controller or be split across workers, and how many. v0.2.0 adds read-only cross-provider handoff: a claimed worker attempt can be re-pointed to another provider in self-contained T1 mode, gated by a field- and classification-level egress policy, with every egress journaled in an auditable ledger. v0.1.0 automatic controller selection, the six public plugin contracts, and the runtime trace UI remain.
highlights: Read-only cross-provider handoff (FR-301): `POST /v1/tasks/{task_id}/handoff` re-points a claimed WorkerAttempt to a target provider in T1 mode; the target never gains controller authority.

Egress audit (FR-302): `EgressPolicy` allows only public/internal classifications by default (restricted never leaves), enforces field prefixes, and `EgressLedger` journals every egress with source/target provider, fields, and classification, surviving journal replay; `GET /v1/egress` filters by task and provider.
Automatic controller selection (v0.1, FR-201/202): sticky certified-controller selection with safe expected-version-protected atomic switch.
Public plugin contracts (v0.1, FR-204): Profiler, Controller Selector, Worker Policy, Provider, Framework, and Verifier as runtime-checkable Protocols with a validating registry.
Read-only runtime trace UI (v0.1, FR-205): `GET /v1/trace/ui` aggregates sessions, epochs, tasks, attempts, and shadow records with HTML-escaped values.
Read-only advisory routing (v0.0.2): boundary classification, requirement profiler, candidate suggestions with cost/latency estimates, and durable shadow records.
Offline evaluation set with three frozen task families and live A/B/C measurements; 36-item design acceptance checklist verified.
Simplified-Chinese README (README.zh-CN.md) alongside the English one.
verification: Design section 23 acceptance checklist: 36 of 36 items verified
13 new tests cover handoff, egress policy gating, ledger replay, idempotent handoff, and egress query filtering
compatibility: Python 3.11+ (tests run on 3.11 in CI; 3.10 development environment)
Local single-process orchestration only; no database or Redis required
OpenAI-compatible endpoint via chat/completions for the evaluation harness
limitations: Handoff is read-only T1 only: the target provider executes the handed-off attempt without controller authority; no T2/T3 write, tool, or recovery handoff.
By default only public/internal data classifications may egress; restricted data never leaves the trusted provider unless the policy explicitly allows it.
Worker delegation stays disabled until the offline evaluation set demonstrates quality, cost, or latency gains.
Evaluation acceptance is keyword-based, not full task execution; quality_claim is false and no model-quality certification is implied.
Production authentication and remote deployment hardening are outside this local-first release evidence.
